info.title: pstore native API
info.description: The native HTTP API of pstore (M220). This document is the contract: the server is tested against it (crates/pstore-server/tests/it/openapi.rs) and the clients are generated from it. Every request body field set is the set the server accepts; every response object is closed, so a field the server answers and this document does not name fails the conformance test. Objects described only in prose (filters, rank_by, facets and the like) are typed here by name and documented in docs/api-migrations.md.

bearer.description: An HS256 token naming tenant and scopes (M127). Each operation's security lists the one scope it needs; no scope implies another.

tenantHeader.name: x-pstore-tenant
tenantHeader.description: An unsecured deployment only (no PSTORE_AUTH_CONFIG): the tenant, a decimal id. Under bearer auth the token's tenant decides.

Tenant.name: x-pstore-tenant
Tenant.description: The tenant, on an unsecured deployment.

Session.name: x-pstore-session
Session.description: A session token an earlier answer returned: a session query reads at least what it names (M11.1).

Cost.description: What the request cost in blob-store requests and bytes. Native: present on every answer that touches the store.

ErrorCode.description: Stable across releases: the field a client switches on. x-pstore-status gives each code's HTTP status.

message.description: For a human reading a log; not stable.

retryable.description: Derived from the status: true for 429 and 5xx only.

Id.description: A document id: a string, or an integer in 0..=2^64-1 for a uint64-keyed index. A uuid-keyed index answers ids as canonical uuid strings.

Epoch.description: A HEAD commit's number; increases with every commit.

DistanceMetric.description: How $dist is computed. cosine_distance is 1 - cos(q, v) and euclidean_squared is |q - v|^2: lower is nearer. dot_product answers -(q . v): lower is nearer too.

Vector.description: A dense vector: an array of numbers, or a base64 string of little-endian f32 (D-36).

vectors.description: Named dense fields (M190): each field one vector or several, spelled as vector is.

sparse.description: A sparse vector: string keys to weights (M178).

attributes.description: Attribute values. A null value is the absent attribute (M174).

durability.description: batched: buffered in this process, visible to its queries, not yet in the blob store. durable: written as one bundle object before the answer. applied: durable, then answered once a fold applied it, with what it did (M129; refused unless the deployment enables it).

distance_metric.description: The metric this write assumes, dot_product when absent. It must be the index's: a write naming another is refused schema_conflict.

patch_rows.description: Rows to patch: id and attributes only (M134).

upsert_condition.description: A filter each upsert's old row must pass (M133).

patch_condition.description: A filter each patch's old row must pass (M133).

delete_condition.description: A filter each delete's old row must pass (M133).

delete_by_filter.description: Delete every row the filter matches (M136).

patch_by_filter.description: Patch every row the filter matches (M136).

delete_by_filter_allow_partial.description: Apply a large delete_by_filter in pages (M137).

patch_by_filter_allow_partial.description: Apply a large patch_by_filter in pages (M137).

branch_from_namespace.description: Create this index as a copy-on-write branch of another (M16).

copy_from_namespace.description: Create this index as a copy of another.

affected_ids.description: With durability applied, answer the ids each operation affected (M130).

idempotency_key.description: A key from POST .../idempotency-keys: the write is applied at most once (M132).

WriteRequest.description: A write: upserts, patches, deletes and conditions, applied in a fixed order (M130).

rows_remaining.description: A partial by-filter operation left rows: send it again (M137).

durable.description: In the blob store before this answer.

session.description: A session token: send it as x-pstore-session to read this write (M11.1).

outcome_unavailable.description: The write was applied but its outcome was reaped before it was read (M132).

replayed.description: An idempotency key's retry: the first request's answer (M132).

dims.description: The vector width; 0 for a text-only index (M170).

PatchIndexRequest.description: Make an index read-only or writable (M149), or change its storage settings (M231). Names one or both.

Committed.description: The commit a request made, or the epoch it found.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

text_fields.description: Further text fields and their analyzers (M152).

vectors.description: Named dense fields and their widths.

vector_types.description: Declared element types per dense field (M195).

unfolded.description: A write is acknowledged and not yet folded.

vector_search.description: Per dense field: rows ANN searches, rows scanned exactly (M198).

rerank.description: With mode fde, exact re-scores the candidates.

rerank_window.description: Candidates a rerank re-scores a segment.

MultiVectorQuery.description: A MaxSim query over a field of several vectors a row (M61).

field.description: The dense field vector searches; the primary when absent.

include_vectors.description: Project stored vectors: true or field names (M179).

limit_per.description: At most n results per attribute value (M146).

text.description: BM25 legs: a string, or an array of strings and {field, query, last_as_prefix} objects (M155, M180).

fusion.description: How legs combine: rrf (the default), sum or max (M9g).

as_of.description: Read the index as this past epoch held it (M114).

include_attributes.description: true for every attribute, false for none, or names.

exact.description: Scan exactly rather than through ANN.

rank_by.description: An order (an attribute and asc or desc) or a scoring expression (M182; numeric nodes M203).

consistency.description: eventual (the default), strong, session or bounded (M11).

explain.description: Answer the plan the query ran (M165).

QueryRequest.description: One query. Ranked by vector, text or sparse legs, ordered by rank_by, or aggregated.

rerank_by.description: An outer fusion of the queries' results (M142).

MultiQueryRequest.description: Several queries in one request, one snapshot (M9g, M131). A sub-query carries neither queries, explain nor include_vectors, and limit and offset apply only beside rerank_by: each is refused (400).

VectorOut.description: As vector_encoding asked: floats or base64.

score.description: The fused score: higher ranks first. Under RRF it is the sum of 1/(60 + rank) over the legs.

$dist.description: The vector distance under the index's metric: lower is nearer. Absent on an order or a text-only query.

attributes.description: The projected attributes. An attribute the row does not have is absent, never null.

ResultRow.description: One result. Rows come in rank order: score descending, or the order rank_by names.

unfolded_hits.description: Results served from writes not yet folded.

MultiQueryResponse.description: Each query's answer in request order, and one cost.

RecallResponse.description: The index's recall at one snapshot (M162).

Duties.description: What this deployment leaves to its operator.

tenant.description: A tenant id, decimal; this request's tenant when absent.

store.description: A source store PSTORE_SOURCES names; this store when absent or empty.

schema.description: Rebuild under this schema: a reindex (M168).

as_of.description: Copy the source as this past epoch held it (M196).

CopyStatus.description: An isolated copy, export or reindex, as an operation with a status (M166).

ReplicationRequest.description: A replication follows its source's present and schema, always read-only: read_only, schema and as_of are a copy's, and refused here.

source_folded.description: The source was folded in this store before the sync.

source.description: The object's URL; its prefix must be allowed.

ExternalRegisterRequest.description: An external index over the customer's own object (M86).

window.description: Candidates re-scored, at least k: 4 x k when absent.

StorageSettings.description: What an index's next fold or compaction writes (M231): its overrides over the server's defaults. Segments already written stay as they are.

StorageOverrides.description: The settings an index overrides (M231); any other takes the server's default.

StoragePatch.description: Storage settings to change (M231): absent leaves a setting, null clears its override, a value sets it.
